create.name: Sarah McLean
create.bio:
Sarah McLean is a meditation and mindfulness teacher who founded the McLean Meditation Institute and its Meditation Teacher Academy, a programme that has trained hundreds of meditation teachers since 2012. She took up daily meditation around 1989 and soon went to live at a Transcendental Meditation community in Massachusetts, where she first worked with Deepak Chopra; she later spent eight years as education director at the Chopra Center in California. Wanting to find the roots of the practice, she then lived for a time in an ashram in Kerala and for two years at a remote Zen training centre, where she was the cook.

Her teaching draws on Vedanta, Zen, mindfulness, contemplative prayer and self-inquiry, and she keeps the methods plain and practical for beginners as well as long-time meditators. For many years she ran a meditation centre in Sedona, Arizona; she now lives in Santa Barbara, California, where she leads monthly community sittings and a salon for experienced meditators, alongside online gatherings and her teacher training. Her books Soul-Centered and The Power of Attention set out her approach, and her YouTube channel holds many full-length guided meditations.

books.title: Soul-Centered: Transform Your Life in 8 Weeks with Meditation
books.author: Sarah McLean
books.description: An eight-week programme that introduces her five essentials of meditation and walks through seated, walking and eating practices step by step. It is interwoven with stories from her years in an ashram and a Zen monastery.

books.title: The Power of Attention: Awaken to Love
books.author: Sarah McLean
books.description: Her second book, on how the way we place our attention shapes experience, with meditations for turning attention towards love and connection.

courses.title: Meditation & Mindfulness Teacher Certification (Meditation Teacher Academy)
courses.description: A 300-hour certification for people who want to teach meditation and mindfulness, starting with a period of deepened personal practice and ending in a virtual intensive with a teaching practicum. Cohorts run regularly, with a waitlist for the next one.
courses.price: Early Bird Tuition is $2895 USD; Tuition is $3795 USD

courses.title: First Sundays Community Meditation (Santa Barbara)
courses.description: A monthly in-person sitting at a yoga studio in Santa Barbara, with gentle guidance, a twenty-minute guided meditation and time to talk with others. Newcomers and returning meditators are welcome.

free_resources.title: Guided meditations with Sarah McLean (YouTube playlist)
free_resources.description: The playlist her website points to for free guided meditations, most of them full-length sittings of about forty minutes covering gratitude, loving-kindness, self-inquiry, zazen and more.

Her site says it 'is currently being refreshed'; the teacher-training page still names an April 2026 cohort as next, so the training is listed undated as a repeating programme.

Books: Soul-Centered (ISBN 1401935869) and The Power of Attention (1401942253) are Hay House books; ASINs from the Amazon links on her own site (Amazon not opened, hayhouse.com not fetched). Not confirmed elsewhere.
One video (Love Yourself) is on Hay House's YouTube channel, where she is the only speaker.
Her about page describes her own past anxiety and her Army work with soldiers' PTSD; not used in the bio. Her past Chopra Center role involved Ayurveda and 'natural healing'; not used.
Photo: YouTube channel avatar (900 x 900), looked at; her site's images are logos, banners and stock photos.
I fetched the yt3.googleusercontent.com image before reading that host's robots.txt (which returns a 400 error page, i.e. no robots file); a slip in order.
